messages:
tanya_sales: Heads up 1 POC acct=acct_RND42 reporting free credits dropped from 18k -> 200 overnight during a stress run. they saw lots of 429 and reconnect logs. can we swarm? :weary:
ben_support: on it. can they paste a tiny client log and confirm SDK + whether they stream responses or do full requests?
tanya_sales: customer says node-sdk v1.2.5, using streaming over websockets with automatic reconnect in their edge client. pasted snippet:
```
[2026-05-12T02:10:03Z] WARN ws disconnected, reconnecting
[2026-05-12T02:10:04Z] INFO request started tokens=900 route=/v1/stream
[2026-05-12T02:10:06Z] INFO ws reconnected, resending last chunk
[2026-05-12T02:10:07Z] ERROR http 429
[2026-05-12T02:10:09Z] INFO request complete req=req_s7 tokens=1800
```
ben_support: interesting: reconnection + resend then final counted 1800 tokens. that could be double-counting between initial and re-sent fragments. ryan, any known behavior with streaming & reconnects?
ryan_engineer: we had a streaming reconnect change in early-April where fragments are accepted as independent sub-requests if the client resends, which can cause extra token accounting. but we try to coalesce if request idempotency is present. node-sdk v1.2.5 predates the idempotency headers on reconnect. request window: pulling server logs for acct_RND42 02:08-02:12...
ryan_engineer: server snippet: 
```
[2026-05-12T02:10:03Z] req_id=req_s5 status=202 fragments=1 tokens=900 route=/v1/stream
[2026-05-12T02:10:04Z] req_id=req_s6 status=408 fragments=1 tokens=900 route=/v1/stream
[2026-05-12T02:10:07Z] req_id=req_s7 status=200 fragments=2 tokens=1800 route=/v1/stream
```
ryan_engineer: shows both early fragments and later full completion consumed tokens. if client resends fragments on reconnect, those fragments may be billed. it's not classic identical full-request retry, but still extra consumption.
claire_finance: ledger shows acct_RND42 consumed 17,820 units between 02:00-02:15. free_credit was 18,000 at 02:00. ledger_bot, any automated flags?
ledger_bot: anomaly: repeated small-fragment tokens followed by larger completed tokens within 5-10s window. flagged for manual review.
ben_support: we should offer immediate mitigations: 1) have customer upgrade node-sdk to v1.4+ which merges fragments and sets idempotency on reconnects, 2) temporarily lower their worker retry behavior to avoid resending fragments, 3) we'll bump concurrency to reduce 429s while they patch. ops_bot: can you apply a short bump?
ops_bot: change submitted: increase concurrency for acct_RND42 from 6 -> 14 for 8h. ticket id: infra_patch_20260512_03.
claire_finance: propose a goodwill credit to cover excess fragment-billing while they fix. estimate duplicate-ish consumption = ~820 units (difference between ledger and expected unique tokens). need eng confirmation.
ryan_engineer: quick dedupe check: from logs there are ~10 fragmented replays where fragment tokens (900) then full req (1800) resulted in an extra 900 each -> ~9,000. but some fragments are legitimate partial progress and would be billed. conservative refund recommendation = 4,500 credits as good faith, and give detailed logs so customer sees pattern.
tanya_sales: customer is demoing in 6 hours, they'd accept a partial credit and the concurrency bump. i'll propose 4.5k credit + guidance.
ben_support: also recommend adding a KB note for streaming clients: "if using websockets/streaming, ensure SDK >= v1.4 or set X-Idempotency-Key for reconnects; avoid blind fragment replays; use final status endpoint". I'll draft it.
claire_finance: billing_bot queued credit action: acct=acct_RND42 amount=4500 reason="excess consumption from streaming reconnect fragments" status=pending_approval.
ledger_bot: note for audit: original balance 18000 -> 17820 after consumption; proposed goodwill credit 4500 pending. attach server fragments log.
ryan_engineer: longer-term: propose runtime change to fingerprint streaming fragments and discount re-sent fragments within 10s if payload overlap >70%. filing RFC to runtime team.
tanya_sales: customer replied: "Thanks 1 We'll pause reconnects for demo and upgrade SDK after. Appreciate the quick credit offer and the bump." :pray: closing loop unless finance needs more details.
claire_finance: will fast-track approval and update thread when posted. audit note: cause=streaming reconnect + fragment resend; mitigation=KB + SDK upgrade + runtime RFC.
ben_support: KB draft will include sample header for idempotency: 
```
X-Idempotency-Key: <uuid-per-session-fragment>
```
ops_bot: infra_patch_20260512_03 will auto-revert at 2026-05-12T10:30:00Z unless extended.
tanya_sales: thanks team 1 marking resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
